citations.quote: Name: Sylas. Official role tags: Mage, Assassin.

core_mechanics.summary: Sylas is a mage and assassin.

purpose: Recognize his fighting pattern and main threats.
title: Sylas

citations.quote: Sylas' ability casts generate stacks of Unshackled that stack up to a cap. While he has stacks, he gains tremendous bonus attack speed.

core_mechanics.summary: Ability casts store charges and grant attack speed while charges remain.

citations.quote: Sylas' next basic attack consumes a stack to whirl his chains around him, dealing magic damage to the target and reduced magic damage to nearby enemies.

core_mechanics.summary: Charged attacks deal magic damage with reduced damage to nearby enemies.

purpose: Recognize empowered attacks after spell casts.
title: Petricite Burst

citations.quote: Sylas lashes out two chains that converge at the target location, dealing magic damage to enemies hit and slowing them for a brief moment. After a brief delay, the intersection explodes to deal magic damage to enemies within.

core_mechanics.summary: Converging chains damage and slow, followed by a delayed explosion at their intersection.

purpose: Recognize the initial slow and delayed damage area.
title: Chain Lash

citations.quote: Sylas dashes to the target enemy and strikes them to deal magic damage. If this hits a champion, Sylas is also healed, increased based on his missing health.

core_mechanics.summary: A targeted damaging dash heals Sylas against champions, with increased healing based on missing health.

purpose: Recognize his targeted engage and low-health recovery.
title: Kingslayer

citations.quote: Sylas dashes to the target location. He can then cast Abduct within a short time.

core_mechanics.summary: An initial dash opens a brief window to cast Abduct.

citations.quote: Sylas whips his chains in the target direction that deal magic damage and briefly stun the first enemy hit, revealing them. He will then dash to the target and briefly knock them up upon arrival.

core_mechanics.summary: The chain damages, reveals and stuns the first enemy hit, then brings Sylas to them for a knock-up.

purpose: Recognize the dash followed by his chain engage.
title: Abscond / Abduct

citations.quote: Shape-shifting ultimates will transform Sylas into the target's alternate form, replacing his basic abilities and base stats.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Copied shape-shifting ultimates can replace his basic abilities and base stats with an alternate form.

citations.quote: Hijack's per target cooldown is indicated by a ring under recently targetted enemy champions, and is only visible to Sylas and each individual enemy.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The per-target cooldown has a ring indicator visible to Sylas and the affected enemy.

citations.quote: gaining a copy of their ultimate ability and briefly revealing them.

core_mechanics.summary: Hijack copies an enemy champion's ultimate and briefly reveals them.

citations.quote: He cannot steal from the same champion again for a while, and can hold the hijacked ability for some time, during which he can recast Hijack. Recast: Sylas casts his hijacked ability at no cost.

core_mechanics.summary: The copy can be held temporarily and cast at no cost; the same champion cannot immediately be copied again.

citations.quote: Hijacked abilities that do not scale with ability power have their attack damage ratios converted to ability power ratios.

core_mechanics.summary: Copied abilities without AP scaling convert their AD ratios to AP ratios.

purpose: Recognize the variable ultimate threat and repeat-steal restriction.
title: Hijack
